stroke.Parent = frame

button.BorderSizePixel = 0

button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
button.TextSize = SETTINGS.TextSize
button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

button.Parent = frame

--// ================================
--// RGB FÜGGVÉNY
--// ================================

local function startRGB(object)

	task.spawn(function()

		local hue = 0

		while object.Parent do

			hue += 0.01

			if hue >= 1 then
				hue = 0
			end

			object.Color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)

			task.wait(SETTINGS.RGBSpeed / 10)

		end

	end)

end

-- RGB a gomb körül
startRGB(stroke)

	platform.Position = position

	platform.CanCollide = true

	mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh

	-- A platform alapformája maradjon lapos
	mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)

	-- RGB
	startRGB(platform)

end)

• Game-Engine Accuracy — Runs the game's actual physics behind the scenes so the lines match real shots perfectly. No guesswork involved.

• Target Ball Lines — See where the ball you hit is heading, along with its own bank bounces and deflections.

• Pocket & Scratch Alerts — Turns into a ring marker when a ball is going in, and warns you in bright red if the cue ball is about to scratch.

• Bank Shot Markers — Clean rings show the exact spot a ball will bounce off the cushions.
